name: select
title: Select
description: Materialize selects: a Radix-powered dropdown, a styled native select and a multiple select with checkboxes.
improvements: Built on Radix Select: touch taps pick the tapped option (the iOS wrong-item bug) and the dropdown never opens and closes immediately.
The dropdown is portaled and repositioned with collision detection, so it is never clipped by modals or overflow: hidden containers.
Fully controlled or uncontrolled: values changed from React state show up right away, with no re-initialisation.
Proper ARIA (combobox and listbox) and keyboard support: arrows, Home/End, type-ahead, Enter/Space and Escape with focus return.
Works in native forms (name, required) and ships a NativeSelect for touch devices and a MultiSelect with checkboxes.
